purpose: Cross-check the binomial labels in the 2015 Bega watershed paper against Eschmeyer's Catalog of Fishes without reidentifying preserved specimens or adopting the article's old status categories.

authority.name: Eschmeyer's Catalog of Fishes
authority.publisher: California Academy of Sciences, Institute for Biodiversity Science and Sustainability
authority.access: Official indexed Catalog records were reviewed. Individual entries display different update dates; normal direct opens may be blocked. No access challenge was bypassed.
authority.reuse: No item-specific open license for republishing Catalog text was established. This audit records only short attributed name-status and range summaries with links.

nameDecisions.disposition: Nomenclatural result only. No Bega sample, image, or voucher was reidentified.
Nomenclatural result only. No Bega sample, image, or voucher was reidentified.

nameDecisions.notes: The entry's short distribution summary names Timor and Maluku in Indonesia and does not list the Philippines. This is not treated as a range-absence finding.
nameDecisions.disposition: Name status is accepted as printed; verify local specimen identity and distribution before adopting the article's native-status label.

nameDecisions.notes: The entry explains the original spelling and gives a short distribution summary naming Indonesia and uncertain Bangladesh, but not the Philippines. This is not treated as proof of absence; it leaves the article's endemic-status claim unresolved.
nameDecisions.disposition: Name status is accepted as printed; do not adopt the paper's endemic-status label without specimen-level identification and an independent Philippine range review.

unresolvedLabels.reason: Genus-only label; no epithet is available for a species-level name crosswalk.
Genus-only label; no epithet is available for a species-level name crosswalk.

comparativeEvidence.note: Catalog status confirms current nomenclatural combinations, not the identity of 2014 specimens. The article's native/endemic/introduced codes refer to FishBase (2014); the short Catalog range notes for Sicyopterus micrurus and Dermogenys pusilla do not independently corroborate the paper's local status labels and are not used as absence evidence.

limitations: The Catalog crosswalk does not verify the taxonomic identity of preserved samples; no voucher accession was reported in the primary paper.
The malformed site-coordinate strings still prevent reliable site georeferencing.
The two genus-only labels cannot be resolved from the source text and should remain genus-only.
The selected ECoF entry pages have different update dates; their status reflects the indexed entry as accessed on this review date.
A short Catalog range note that omits a country is not evidence of biological absence from that country.
nextAction: Run a bounded GBIF and museum-collection locality search for Bega watershed, Bega Falls, Enchanted Falls, Tiger Falls, Malipaga River and Prosperidad. Treat any results as voucher candidates only; the primary paper's coordinate ambiguity and the two genus-only labels remain unresolved.
